name: Blazon
desc: A heraldic achievement -- an escutcheon divided (per pale, per fess, quarterly) and charged with an ordinary and mobile charges (mullets, roundels, fleurs, lozenges, crescents), set inside a twisted torse and a spray of slashed mantling that flutters continuously on incommensurate rates so the arms never sit still while a gilt highlight sweeps down the shield; tinctures are rendered in the true engraver's hatching (azure horizontal, gules vertical, sable cross-hatch, vert bendwise, or dotted), or painted in full colour, gilt relief, or leaded stained glass; each seed re-blazons a new coat of arms.

energy.doc: gilt glow, highlight and tincture brightness

scale.doc: size of the shield and its surrounding achievement

speed.doc: rate of the mantling flutter and gilt sweep

style.doc: aesthetic: engraver's tincture-hatching on parchment / full-colour painted heraldry / embossed gilt seal / leaded stained glass

seed.doc: deterministic -- re-blazons the coat: field division, tinctures, ordinary and charges
